stories.title: Wire register SoC% into the bench drain-CLI + US-234 cold-start guard (BL-015, deps US-426)
stories.completionNotes: US-427 DONE (code-complete; the UPS-drain-rig bench drill is a PM/bench gate -- no MAX17048 on dev, Pi is a deploy target). record_drain_test.py: new readCalibratedRegisterSocPct(monitor, uptimeSeconds, calibrationWindowSeconds=180) reads UpsMonitor.getBatteryPercentage() ONLY when past the cold-start window; _recordEvent now constructs a UpsMonitor (injectable for tests), reads the register at open+close via the guard, and passes startSocPct/endSocPct into the US-426 recorder kwargs -> start_soc_pct/end_soc_pct (separate from the operator --start-soc voltage slot, which still lands in start_vcell_v). Cold-start guard (US-234): uptime<180s OR uptime unknowable OR read-raises -> NULL, never a garbage percent (honest-instrument, Atlas BL-015 ruling). Uptime sourced from /proc/uptime (None off-Linux -> NULL, so a dev-box run records NULL not garbage). _printResult + docstring show the two _soc_pct slots. TD-058 cleanup: removed the dead batteryHealthRecorder chain end-to-end -- hardware_manager constructor param + self._batteryHealthRecorder store + BatteryHealthRecorder import + factory param/pass-through, AND lifecycle.py _createBatteryHealthRecorder() + its call/wiring (ghost of the SS-T5-deleted PowerDownOrchestrator, 0 callers of startDrainEvent/endDrainEvent in src/). Fixed a dangling :meth: docstring cross-ref in _createPowerLogWriter. IN-LOOP GATE: ruff clean on all 4 touched files; targeted 18 drain-test + 54 touched-module tests (hardware_manager/lifecycle/orchestrator-update) green; DB-validation tests query the real battery_health_log row (DoD #5). PM GATES OWED: (1) full pytest suite + mypy (base modules hardware_manager + lifecycle changed -> prioritize regression); (2) IRL bench drill on the UPS-drain rig -- outside cold-start window a closed row has start/end_soc_pct populated from the register; a drill opened within ~3 min of power-up records NULL. NOTE: cold-start proxy = system uptime (/proc/uptime); the MAX17048 keeps calibration across a Pi reboot while the UPS holds battery, so uptime is a conservative floor (may suppress a genuinely-calibrated gauge after a bare Pi reboot -> NULL, the safe direction). Flag to Atlas if a gauge-power-persistent signal is wanted later.

stories.title: Carousel honest-availability -- per-source availability + typed-NA emitters (SSOT pattern; fixes Bug-3)
acceptance: build to specs/ssot-design-pattern.md 'Honest availability -- the unavailable-source -> typed-NA pattern' (Atlas-ratified 2026-07-01)
each source (obd-link, ups, dtc) has ONE state.source.<x> = available|unavailable (availability is one truth per SOURCE, not per parameter)
the 3 shipped emitters (system-status, battery-health, dtc) write a FRESH real-or-(NULL+reason) state EACH tick -- never leave stale
NA is NULL+reason, NEVER a numeric sentinel anywhere (state or DB) -- no pd_stage=-1-class trap
display renders 'NA (<reason>)' for an unavailable source (e.g. car-off/wall-power -> 'OBD: off', engine params 'NA (no OBD)') -- honest, not blank cards
the DTC severity takeover (US-405) fires ONLY on a real new code, NEVER on absent/empty state (subsumes Bug-3b -- an absent source reads unavailable, not 'no codes -> alert')
fixture/DOM tests per source-state; bench-verifiable (OBD-down case IS wall power -- no car needed); ruff check passes

validationCriteria.action: render the carousel with obd-link unavailable (wall power, no OBD)
validationCriteria.outcome: shows 'OBD: off' + engine params 'NA (no OBD)'; no blank/stale cards; no numeric NA sentinel in state or DB

validationCriteria.action: render with empty/absent dtc state, then with a real MAJOR code
validationCriteria.outcome: empty -> no takeover (normal carousel); MAJOR -> takeover fires
the next tick writes NULL+reason (not the stale prior value)

stories.goal: As the CIO, I want the carousel emitters to always write fresh real-or-typed-NA state per source availability, so the 3.5-inch display is honest when a source is down (never blank/stale/fabricated) and the CHECK-ENGINE takeover never mis-fires on an absent source.
